desc: Navy officials are considering changing the name of a future aircraft carrier originally named after Doris “Dorie” Miller, a Black sailor hero of Pearl Harbor.

title: Florida Officer Accused of Repeatedly Tracking Estranged Wife Through License Plate Cameras
desc: A Florida police officer is accused of using the department's Flock Safety license plate reader system to track his estranged wife's vehicle more than 700 times over nearly two years.

title: Packers RB Josh Jacobs Faces Two Misdemeanor Charges After May Incident
desc: Green Bay Packers running back Josh Jacobs is facing two misdemeanor criminal charges stemming from an alleged confrontation with his girlfriend at his Wisconsin home in May.

title: Himalayan Disaster Unleashes Deadly Floods as Glacier Collapse Ravages Nepal-Tibet Border
desc: A catastrophic glacier collapse on the Nepal-Tibet border has left hundreds dead and over 1,300 missing as debris-filled floods ravage Himalayan communities.

title: ICE Awards $16.7 Million Contract for Electric Shock Gloves Amid Growing Concerns Over Use of Force
desc: ICE has awarded a $16.7 million contract for 6,000 electric shock gloves, drawing sharp criticism from lawmakers and civil rights advocates over use of force concerns.

title: Lana Condor Opens the Door to a Jubilee Comeback as Marvel Builds Its Next X-Men Team
desc: Lana Condor has reached out to Marvel about returning as Jubilee in the upcoming X-Men reboot, as the studio builds its new mutant team for 2028.
